# ztna_connector_group_upgrade_status (Data Source)

Get Connector Group Scheduled Upgrade Status



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oid` (String) Parent connector OID.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) List of connector upgrade statuses within this group
- `name` (String) Connector group name
- `rolling_upgrade` (Boolean) Whether rolling upgrade is enabled for this connector group
- `tfid` (String)
- `upgrade_status` (String) Overall upgrade status for the connector group
